### Bug Description

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

A clear description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots / Error Logs
If applicable, attach screenshots or terminal error logs to help explain the problem.

### Environment Details
- OS: Windows / Linux / macOS
- Node version: `node -v`
- Browser (if UI): Chrome / Firefox / Safari
